title: Free-form Association Tasks Reveal Stereotype Hallucination in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Eliciting first-order (direct) and second-order (predicted group) word associations to ambiguous visual stimuli (Republicans vs. Democrats) and evaluating stereotype hallucination using Shannon entropy, LLM-based classification for group separability, and PCA of semantic embeddings.
